atomic_gap: The v1 publication closeout declares open_proposal_only_coordinates=[] and all_core_coordinates_promotion_grade_closed=true, but its ancestry does not contain the separately frozen target-validation consolidation successor from PR #569. That successor exists because the strongest low-level structural-memory append parent can accept caller-asserted VERIFIED_LOCAL authority without successful target validation. A Paper-III closeout can therefore appear promotion-grade while omitting a known runtime authority coordinate.

successor_contract.name: Paper-III closeout dependency-integrity gate v2
rules: A closeout may not claim all core mechanics closed unless every known Paper-III promotion successor is present in the release ancestry, not merely named in prose.
The target-validation consolidation protocol, implementation and tests must be present and content-bound in the closeout subject.
The target-validation successor must have a successful dedicated exact-head promotion gate before the closeout records its conditional mechanic terminal.
The promotion matrix and final receipt must expose the target-validation coordinate explicitly; omission is blocking, not equivalent to closure.
Pull-request CI must bind the PR head SHA explicitly rather than treating GitHub's synthetic merge SHA as the release subject.
The v1 closeout artifacts remain historical evidence and are not rewritten; v2 records the discovered residual and supersedes v1 for release authority.
No dependency-integrity result grants scientific/theorem authority, ResearchTool promotion, or model-level efficacy.

preserved_negatives: no independent external semantic-novelty validation at the frozen cutoff
